text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while pushing hard in training
ahead of the fast-approaching Oka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, Grandmother.
Please take your time and enjoy the view."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"May I stay by your side?
—Trainer."
choice_data_list: O-Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the Mejiro family, there is someone beloved as "Grandmother" by all the Mejiro Umamusume, whose counsel they all seek.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That grandmother suddenly visited the Academy,
saying, "I want to see Mejiro Ramonu run."
choice_data_list: (I'm so nervous...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Speaking of the Mejiro family's Grandmother, alongside the Symboli family, she is a legend who has long supported the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, I would never have any connection with her.
She's a person from a whole different world, one that even the kids from the Mejiro family are said to fear, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu, these words are likely needless for you,
but please run without paying any heed to me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because I... might try to put on airs
in front of Grandmaman, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
...It seems that was unnecessary after all.
Now then, have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter who her opponent is,
it seems Mejiro Ramonu remains unchanged."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin Racecourse, 1600 meters...
...The Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mejiro Ramonu run is always a beautiful sight.
Even more polished than in her Junior year, her brilliance shines brighter with every stride...
choice_data_list: (It really is... perfect.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: —She's quite marvelous, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
If it is her, she can achieve the long-cherished wish
that the Mejiro family has never once reached.
choice_data_list: Conquering the Classics... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family has produced stellar results in major races,
including prestigious Senior Class races like the Tenno Sho.
However, among those open to the Classic Class—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had never had much luck when it came to prestigious races in particular. I've heard that winning one has been a long-cherished dream for her entire family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
You are quite well-read.
Indeed. However, right now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Ramonu is there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"When she was little, her legs were frail and unsteady...
In a manner of speaking—she was incomplete."
choice_data_list: (That's right, last time Aldan also...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Ane-sama... became the person she is today
only after making painstaking, blood-soaked efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ane-sama's devotion back in those days... was truly terrifying. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
—What do you think?
Right now, that girl is perfection itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: To bring the Mejiro family their first Classic title and achieve the first Triple Tiara in history...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt, it's that girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――...Head in the clouds.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother is
a very kind person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why do you
cast your eyes down?
choice_data_list: ...Once again, I feel the weight of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The expectations resting on her shoulders are extraordinary. In a race you can only enter once in a lifetime, everyone assumes she is destined to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the race right before my eyes, I understood the weight of it.
—It's immense pressure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"How strange.
Even though it isn't yours."
choice_data_list: How are you able to carry that?
How are you able to shoulder all that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because I'm confident.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My love
is worthy of victory.
choice_data_list: You really are strong.
You're truly strong, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I've grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Far, faaar more than back when... I trembled at even the smallest steps...
choice_data_list: ...Can I ask you about what happened back then?
...Can I ask you about back then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I was an utterly unremarkable,
average child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"While rubbing my legs, I just...
watched the other girls bound across the earth."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Freely, lightly, joyfully...
The joy of their running approached with a dazzling intensity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Dazzling.
So bright it sears the eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have the same legs as they do.
I could run so much better than that.
I should be able to...!

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "......I want to run."

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run... I want to run, I want to run,
I want to run, I want to run, I want to run, I want to run,
I want to run, I want to run, I want to run, I want to run."

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“――...I'll run.
If I don't, this body of mine will burn itself to ashes.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Into something.
Into whatever is burning inside my chest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "And then... I let myself burn, giving into the flames completely."
choice_data_list: So you put in the effort to run, huh.
So you put in the effort to run, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hard work...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I have no recollection of such a thing.
choice_data_list: For Aldan to talk about "blood, sweat, and tears effort"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Blood... ah.
Though I wonder which one you mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Running test after test to find the cause? I did shed a little blood back then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Running day and night just to find my limit? Yes, my nails certainly bled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Or perhaps you mean the rehab.
Blood was always left on my palms."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...No, upon further thought...
None of this really counts as hard work, does it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Letting my love pour out unchecked
was far more painful, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
When I was finally able to run again...
I still can't forget that moment even now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I realized it. It was—love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I loved it.
I wanted to love... racing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to touch it with these legs.
I wanted to be embraced... by that atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to seal it with a kiss.
To victory, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I sought perfection...
Because I was imperfect.
Because being imperfect, I could not be loved."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother saw me for who I truly was...
And guided me—onto this path of love.
choice_data_list: The Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Soon,
I will stand on that starting line."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I am strong.
For I desire it more than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because I love racing more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Now... I must continue my preparations.
So that I may advance as my perfect self...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ramonu became strong.
Putting in tremendous effort,
all to truly love racing.
choice_data_list: (I wonder about myself...)
(I wonder how I'm doing.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I love racing. I truly do. But... have I really strived to be strong enough to say I'd give up everything for it?"
choice_data_list: (…Time to review the Oka Sho one more time!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only those who strive for perfection
can ever attain it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us redouble our efforts,
so we can proudly say we love it to the fullest."
